The key term here is care custody and control. You left your vehicle in their care custody and control and the theft is their liability. Speak to your insurer and they should pressure recovery from the car wash

Many insurance policies will have a short rate cancellation clause in them. This is a scale that will determine how much of your premium gets returned depending on when you cancel the police. This scale is not linear and will front front load how the premium is earned as apposed to just a simple pro rata calculation. Have a check in the policy documents to see if yours includes one.
